title: Tokyo Conference March 1942
definition: A pivotal diplomatic gathering held in Tokyo (March 28–30, 1942) convened by Rash Behari Bose to formalize the formation of the Indian Independence League (IIL) and coordinate the struggle for India's liberation from British rule with Japanese support.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the evolution of the Azad Hind Fauj (INA), the role of the Indian diaspora in the freedom struggle, and the complex geopolitical alignment of Indian revolutionaries during WWII.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Tokyo Conference March 1942.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
